description: Chunky 8-bit pixel art with crisp single-pixel details and two-frame animations; rounded, toy-like animal silhouettes, angular arena tiles, and deep navy outlines. Environments use grassy greens, warm beach sands, or cool pool blues; critters use bright contrasting cream, coral, lime, and lavender, while water hazards and pickups use sparkling cyan with yellow accents. Sunny flat lighting creates a cheerful, mischievous pool-party mood. Strong foreground-background contrast, clean readable silhouettes, and a consistent top-down perspective keep every action legible.
Eight cute animals with idle two-frame walk soak and revenge-duck poses plus five hats
Backyard Beach and Pool Party floors borders boulders and decorative details
Chunky sandcastles with intact and four crumble stages
Inflating wobbling and kicked water balloons
Cross splashes droplets shimmer and colorblind-safe palette
Extra Balloon Big Splash Flippers and Rubber Boots
Pixel panels buttons badges speech bubbles VS cards and results icons
Water droplets sand crumbs soak stars tide foam and confetti
Drop burst escalating chain pickup soak kick tide emote and victory oscillator sounds
Square and triangle chiptune loops for title menu match showdown and results
